lines: NRJN Family Trust (represented by Entrust Family Office Legal & Trusteeship Services Private Limited) is an Investor Selling Shareholder, selling up to 1,050,000 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds of up to ₹141.96 crore if all offered shares are sold.
The timing is at listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, so the liquidity event is near-term and a call is timely now.
Pre-offer holding and average cost of acquisition are unknown and not verified, so gain and retained stake cannot be assessed; confidence is medium.
Proceeds may be slightly lower than the offer price implies, as employee-portion shares are sold at a discount.
